Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.flavors

Enum Class Flavor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Flavor>
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.flavors.Flavor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Flavor>, Constable
public enum Flavor extends Enum<Flavor>
The four petstore rendering flavors shown under Developer > Rendering flavors.
Example:

// The console page for one flavor. View page = Flavor.of("mustache").page();
